prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore to restore deleted episodes and their cuts at their original position while shifting later episodes down and enforcing workspace-member 404 access, added a localized Undo action to the delete toast on the Episodes page, and added backend and browser verification tests.

+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session

+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import StoryCut, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening scene"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(
+    client,
+    headers,
+    episode_id,
+    cut_order=1,
+    script="A rainy bus stop",
+    layout="wide",
+    aspect_ratio="16:9",
+    dialogues=None,
+    appearing_characters=None,
+    image_path="cuts/original/panel1.png",
+):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [{"speaker": "Jin", "text": "Wait for me"}],
+            "appearing_characters": appearing_characters or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    if appearing_characters:
+        with Session(engine) as session:
+            db_cut = session.get(StoryCut, UUID(cut["id"]))
+            db_cut.appearing_characters = appearing_characters
+            session.add(db_cut)
+            session.commit()
+    return cut
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_inserts_after_original_and_copies_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="First Ride", order=1, summary="Boarding the bus")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Second Stop", order=2, summary="Next stop")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Final Stop", order=3, summary="Last stop")
+
+    chars_1 = [{"id": "char-1", "name": "Jin"}]
+    chars_2 = [{"id": "char-2", "name": "Min"}]
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Second panel",
+        layout="close_up",
+        aspect_ratio="1:1",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Min", "text": "Hello"}],
+        appearing_characters=chars_2,
+        image_path="https://cdn.example.com/cut2.png",
+    )
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="First panel",
+        layout="wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Jin", "text": "Let's go"}],
+        appearing_characters=chars_1,
+        image_path="https://cdn.example.com/cut1.png",
+    )
+
+    credits_before = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+    dup_res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert dup_res.status_code == 200, dup_res.text
+    dup = dup_res.json()
+
+    assert dup["id"] != ep1["id"]
+    assert dup["project_id"] == project["id"]
+    assert dup["title"] != ep1["title"]
+    assert ep1["title"] in dup["title"]
+    assert "copy" in dup["title"].lower()
+    assert dup["story_summary"] == "Boarding the bus"
+    assert dup["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert dup["first_cut_image"] == "https://cdn.example.com/cut1.png"
+
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed] == [ep1["id"], dup["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Duplicating the last episode puts the copy at the end
+    dup_last = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert dup_last["episode_order"] == 5
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in listed] == [ep1["id"], dup["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"], dup_last["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in listed] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
+
+    orig_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep1['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    dup_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={dup['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(dup_cuts) == len(orig_cuts) == 2
+
+    for orig_c, dup_c in zip(orig_cuts, dup_cuts):
+        assert dup_c["id"] != orig_c["id"]
+        assert dup_c["episode_id"] == dup["id"]
+        assert dup_c["cut_order"] == orig_c["cut_order"]
+        assert dup_c["script"] == orig_c["script"]
+        assert dup_c["dialogues"] == orig_c["dialogues"]
+        assert dup_c["selected_layout"] == orig_c["selected_layout"]
+        assert dup_c["aspect_ratio"] == orig_c["aspect_ratio"]
+        assert dup_c["appearing_characters"] == orig_c["appearing_characters"]
+        assert dup_c["image_path"] == orig_c["image_path"]
+
+    credits_after = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]

+def test_delete_and_create_keep_contiguous_episode_numbering(client):

+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+
+    # Out-of-range or repeated orders still stay 1, 2, 3... with no gaps or repeats

+    # Duplicate Ep 1 -> [ep1(1), dup(2), ep2(3), ep3(4)]

@@ -0,0 +1,114 @@
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.test_episode_duplicate import _create_cut, _create_episode, _create_project
+
+
+def test_restore_deleted_episode_brings_back_cuts_and_original_position(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1, summary="First")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2, summary="Second")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3, summary="Third")
+
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Ep 2 cut 1",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Wait"}],
+        image_path="https://cdn.example.com/ep2_c1.png",
+    )
+    _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep2["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Ep 2 cut 2",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Go"}],
+        image_path="https://cdn.example.com/ep2_c2.png",
+    )
+
+    # Delete middle episode (ep2 at order 2) -> ep3 shifts to 2
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep3["id"], 2),
+    ]
+
+    # Restore ep2 -> returns to order 2, ep3 shifts back down to 3, cuts intact
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    restored = res.json()
+    assert restored["id"] == ep2["id"]
+    assert restored["title"] == "Ep 2"
+    assert restored["story_summary"] == "Second"
+    assert restored["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert restored["first_cut_image"] == "https://cdn.example.com/ep2_c1.png"
+
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+    restored_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={ep2['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [c["cut_order"] for c in restored_cuts] == [1, 2]
+    assert [c["script"] for c in restored_cuts] == ["Ep 2 cut 1", "Ep 2 cut 2"]
+    assert restored_cuts[0]["image_path"] == "https://cdn.example.com/ep2_c1.png"
+
+    # Delete first episode (ep1 at order 1) -> [ep2(1), ep3(2)], then restore -> [ep1(1), ep2(2), ep3(3)]
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert res.status_code == 200
+    assert res.json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(e["id"], e["episode_order"]) for e in listed] == [
+        (ep1["id"], 1),
+        (ep2["id"], 2),
+        (ep3["id"], 3),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_restore_episode_authorization_and_not_found(client):
+    owner_h = signup(client, email="owner_restore@example.com")
+    stranger_h = signup(client, email="stranger_restore@example.com")
+    teammate_h = signup(client, email="teammate_restore@example.com")
+
+    project = _create_project(client, owner_h)
+    ep = _create_episode(client, owner_h, project["id"], title="Deleted Ep", order=1)
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=owner_h).status_code == 204
+
+    # Unauthenticated -> 401
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
+
+    # Non-member of workspace -> 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=stranger_h).status_code == 404
+
+    # Non-existent episode -> 404
+    assert (
+        client.post(
+            "/api/v1/episodes/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/restore",
+            headers=owner_h,
+        ).status_code
+        == 404
+    )
+
+    # Workspace member -> allowed (200)
+    ws_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner_h).json()[0]["id"]
+    teammate_id = client.get("/api/v1/users/me", headers=teammate_h).json()["id"]
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=UUID(ws_id), user_id=UUID(teammate_id), role="member"))
+        session.commit()
+
+    res = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=teammate_h)
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    assert res.json()["id"] == ep["id"]
+    assert res.json()["episode_order"] == 1
